newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares hit new record, more gains ahead.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares hit new record, more gains ahead.

text.p: The top-20 KFX Danish share index ended on Thursday for the seventh consecutive day at a new all-time record closing high bolstered by rises in bank paper with dealers seeing more advances ahead.

"Although the Dow has slipped a little, I think we're going to see more rises tomorrow particularly for Den Danske Bank after its 1996 result today. Tomorrow's expiry of the February KFX future might create turbulence though," one dealer said.
The KFX index gained 0.41 point to a record high of 159.12, while the KFX March future rose 0.60 point to 158.85 with 1,712 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Den Danske Bank posted lower 1996 pre-tax profits than in the previous year but the result was better than analysts' expectations and after a period of violent yo-yoing the share settled down to close nine crowns higher at 626.
Rival Unidanmark and Jyske Bank, whose results impressed the market less than Den Danske, basked in its sun to put on three and four crowns to finish at 358 and 545 respectively.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.925 billion crowns.
